industry: Senior living communities and adjacent care (independent living, assisted living, memory care; some gold also covers in-home care agencies)
words_and_claims_to_avoid: 'Adult living' / 'adult community' / 'adults only' phrasing when claiming housing-for-older-persons intent (24 CFR 100.306(b))
'We want active, independent seniors only' — can read as disability preference under Fair Housing (describe services/property, not desired body ability)
Fear-mongering abandonment guilt framed as fact ('if you don't move them, you are abandoning them')
Unsubstantiated fill rates, wait-list scarcity, or 'last apartment' urgency
VA / Medicare / Medicaid benefit dollar amounts that imply government partnership or guaranteed eligibility without disclaimers (39 USC 3001; benefit rules)
Resident testimonials or identifiable photos with health/care details without HIPAA (and likeness) authorization
Claiming a care level (memory care, skilled nursing, Medicaid beds) the community is not licensed/authorized to provide
Fake clinical guarantees or 'cures dementia' language
compliance_notes: Fair Housing Act: ads for dwellings must not indicate preference/limitation based on protected classes (24 CFR 100.75). Housing-for-older-persons communities may advertise age intent consistently with 24 CFR Part 100 Subpart E; do not use 'adult living/adult community' language per 100.306(b).
Describe property and services; avoid casting/copy that signals only non-disabled residents are welcome. Include Equal Housing Opportunity logo/statement on housing ads as industry practice.
FTC Act: move-in prices, waived fees, gift cards, and 'limited time' need substantiation, clear restrictions, and real end dates — no deceptive urgency.
State senior-living / AL / nursing home advertising and licensing: print only true license status and care levels; rules vary by state — client confirms.
HIPAA: identifiable resident stories/photos that include health or care information need a valid authorization (45 CFR 164.508) — not buried in admission paperwork alone as a marketing blanket.
VA Aid & Attendance / benefit mailers: do not imply federal endorsement; use required disclaimers if the creative could look governmental (39 USC 3001).
CMS MA/TPMO rules generally apply only to plan marketing — keep pure community ads clean of plan enrollment claims unless the client is actually a plan marketer.
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: relief, care, joy, fear-of-isolation are fine when legal and not deceptive.
Only laws/compliance are hard limits (FHA, FTC, HIPAA, state licensing, 39 USC 3001).
Every angle and emotion_by_offer combo carries sell_the_outcome_line.
Vendor ROI labeled agency-only unverified; never print as fact on a client card.
Prefer one clear offer + one real photo + one QR (roofing-round5 directional).
Dual audience OK; do not invent abandonment guilt as fact.

emotion_by_offer.why: Dominant community gold pattern: $99 first month, waived community fees, moving expense help, rate locks with dated windows.
headline_offer_patterns: 'Waive your community fee (up to $[X]) if you move in by [date]'
'Lock in your rate for [N] years when you move in by [date]'
emotion_by_offer.reinforcing_photo: Warm suite or family welcome moment — not a price sticker alone
emotion_by_offer.what_backfires: Perpetual 'limited time' with no end date; hiding community fees elsewhere; bait pricing unavailable

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Family 'peace of mind' safety messaging vs FHA risk of implying only able-bodied/'independent' residents are welcome
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Compliance wins: sell safety/services and real life; avoid 'active independent only' casting and copy.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Vendor ROI / room-fill claims vs evidence standards
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Agency-only unverified; existence proof of mail use, not printable lift.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: VA benefit dollar headlines in gold vs 39 USC 3001 / eligibility truth
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Law wins: no government look-alike; no guaranteed benefit claims; disclose that eligibility is individual.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Fear/abandonment angles vs Patrick emotion-agnostic stance + deception rules
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Fear OK when evidence-based and non-deceptive; do not frame abandonment guilt as fact.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Home-care gold cards vs community senior-living clients
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Match care setting to the client; do not paste home-care offers onto a community that does not provide them.
